content.value: Suppose, you are the owner of a beverage industry, which is located at an (10) optimum location P and there are other three compromise locations A, B, C. R1 and R2 are the location of raw materials and M is the market. If you are willing to change the location of your industry, which location is you going to prefer and why? You have to keep in mind that the cost of transportation is BDT 20 Tk per unit of material. Necessary data are provided in following Figure and Table.
